description.value:
You've lost favor with the law, but not with the people the law was supposed to serve. A robbery, a broken oath, a defiance of some tyrant's agents — whatever put a price on your head, the common folk of wherever you've passed through see it differently, and they've kept your secrets more than once.

You're a thorn in the side of whichever authority you crossed, and something closer to a protector to everyone else.

system.equipment: A hunting trap, an iron pot, a set of traveler's clothes, and a pouch containing 150 credits.
